boundary: Visual inspection of the declared reconstruction baseline, not an exact source-shader, lighting, animation or source-version camera match. Retained source BAD-labelled and glitch textures are visible limitations.

Central building facades, roofs, connecting bridge, debris and planted areas visible.
Centrifuge room wall graphics, doorway, glass and floor visible; existing gameplay loot crates retained.

Landing, open door and railing visible; coloured source debris/cable textures remain.
Exterior stairs, ramp, neighbouring building, planted areas and street lights visible.
Front facade, vehicles and source textures visible; existing gameplay annex retains its plain material.
Native stairs, planted borders, source building facade and connecting glass bridge visible.

H2 facade, yard and logistics props visible; original BAD-labelled texture variants remain.
